title: HowlForge Role
description: A durable workforce position. A role declares capability requirements and an ordered preference over runtime selectors; it never names a model as its identity.

schema_version.description: Identifies the schema and version this document conforms to.

description.description: What the role is for. Required unless the role inherits one via extends.

extends.description: Parent role to inherit unset fields from. Cycles are refused.

responsibilities.description: What work this role is accountable for.

required_capabilities.description: Capability floors a runtime must meet to be eligible.

fallback_runtimes.description: Ordered substitutes, considered after every preferred runtime.

excluded_runtimes.description: Runtimes that must never fill this role, whatever their capabilities.

handoff_required.description: Whether a worker in this role must leave a handoff bundle.

verification_required.description: Whether work by this role must be verified by someone else. The verification block wins when both are present.

verifier_role.description: The role that must verify this role's output. It must exist and must not be this role.

independent_runtime.description: Whether the verifying runtime must differ from the producing runtime.
